006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter.MetaschemaDataTypeProvider;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.datatype.object.AmbiguousDateTime;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.DateTimeFunctionException;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.InvalidValueForCastFunctionException;
013import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.impl.DateTimeWithoutTimeZoneItemImpl;
014import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IAtomicOrUnionType;
015import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.InvalidTypeMetapathException;
016import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
017
018import java.time.LocalDate;
019import java.time.LocalDateTime;
020import java.time.LocalTime;
021import java.time.OffsetTime;
022import java.time.ZoneId;
023import java.time.ZoneOffset;
024import java.time.ZonedDateTime;
025
026import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
027import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
028
029/**
030 * An atomic Metapath item representing a date/time value in the Metapath
031 * system.
032 * <p>
033 * This interface provides functionality for handling date/time values with and
034 * without time zone information, supporting parsing, casting, and comparison
035 * operations. It works in conjunction with {@link AmbiguousDateTime} to
036 * properly handle time zone ambiguity.
037 */
038public interface IDateTimeItem extends ICalendarTemporalItem {
039  /**
040   * Get the type information for this item.
041   *
042   * @return the type information
043   */
044  @NonNull
045  static IAtomicOrUnionType<IDateTimeItem> type() {
046    return MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.DATE_TIME.getItemType();
047  }
048
049  @Override
050  default IAtomicOrUnionType<? extends IDateTimeItem> getType() {
051    return type();
052  }
053
054  /**
055   * Construct a new date/time item using the provided string {@code value}.
056   *
057   * @param value
058   *          a string representing a date/time
059   * @return the new item
060   */
061  @NonNull
062  static IDateTimeItem valueOf(@NonNull String value) {
063    try {
064      return valueOf(MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.DATE_TIME.parse(value));
065    } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
066      throw new InvalidTypeMetapathException(
067          null,
068          String.format("Invalid date/time value '%s'. %s",
069              value,
070              ex.getLocalizedMessage()),
071          ex);
072    }
073  }
074
075  /**
076   * Get a date/time item based on the provided date and time item values.
077   *
078   * @param date
079   *          the date portion of the date/time
080   * @param time
081   *          the time portion of the date/time
082   * @return the date/time item
083   */
084  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.CyclomaticComplexity")
085  @NonNull
086  static IDateTimeItem valueOf(@NonNull IDateItem date, @NonNull ITimeItem time) {
087    ZonedDateTime zdtDate = ObjectUtils.notNull(date.asZonedDateTime());
088    ZoneId tzDate = date.hasTimezone() ? zdtDate.getZone() : null;
089    OffsetTime zdtTime = ObjectUtils.notNull(time.asOffsetTime());
090    ZoneId tzTime = time.hasTimezone() ? zdtTime.getOffset() : null;
091
092    if (tzDate != null && tzTime != null && !tzDate.equals(tzTime)) {
093      throw new InvalidTypeMetapathException(
094          null,
095          String.format("The date and time values do not have the same timezone value. date='%s', time='%s'",
096              tzDate.toString(),
097              tzTime.toString()));
098    }
099
100    // either both have the same timezone, both are null, or only one has a timezone
101    ZoneId zone = tzDate == null
102        ? tzTime == null ? null : tzTime
103        : tzDate;
104
105    return valueOf(
106        ObjectUtils.notNull(ZonedDateTime.of(
107            zdtDate.toLocalDate(),
108            zdtTime.toLocalTime(),
109            zone == null ? ZoneOffset.UTC : zone)),
110        zone != null);
111  }
112
113  /**
114   * Get the provided item as a date/time item.
115   *
116   * @param item
117   *          the item to convert to a date/time
118   * @return the provided value as a date/time
119   */
120  @NonNull
121  static IDateTimeItem valueOf(@NonNull ICalendarTemporalItem item) {
122    return item instanceof IDateTimeItem
123        ? (IDateTimeItem) item
124        : valueOf(item.asZonedDateTime(), item.hasTimezone());
125  }
126
127  /**
128   * Construct a new date/time item using the provided {@code value}.
129   * <p>
130   * This method handles recording if an explicit timezone was provided using the
131   * {@code hasTimeZone} parameter. The {@link AmbiguousDateTime#hasTimeZone()}
132   * method can be called to determine if timezone information is present.
133   *
134   * @param value
135   *          a date/time, without time zone information
136   * @param hasTimeZone
137   *          {@code true} if the date/time is intended to have an associated time
138   *          zone or {@code false} otherwise
139   * @return the new item
140   * @see AmbiguousDateTime for more details on timezone handling
141   */
142  @NonNull
143  static IDateTimeItem valueOf(@NonNull ZonedDateTime value, boolean hasTimeZone) {
144    return hasTimeZone
145        ? IDateTimeWithTimeZoneItem.valueOf(value)
146        : valueOf(new AmbiguousDateTime(value, false));
147  }
148
149  /**
150   * Construct a new date/time item using the provided local time {@code value}.
151   * <p>
152   * The timezone is marked as ambiguous, meaning the
153   * {@link AmbiguousDateTime#hasTimeZone()} method will return a result of
154   * {@code false}.
155   *
156   * @param value
157   *          the local time value to use
158   * @return the new item
159   * @see AmbiguousDateTime for more details on timezone handling
160   */
161  @NonNull
162  static IDateTimeItem valueOf(@NonNull LocalDateTime value) {
163    return valueOf(new AmbiguousDateTime(ObjectUtils.notNull(value.atZone(ZoneOffset.UTC)), false));
164  }
165
166  /**
167   * Construct a new date/time item using the provided {@code value}.
168   * <p>
169   * This method handles recording if an explicit timezone was provided using the
170   * {@link AmbiguousDateTime}. The {@link AmbiguousDateTime#hasTimeZone()} method
171   * can be called to determine if timezone information is present.
172   *
173   * @param value
174   *          a date/time, without time zone information
175   * @return the new item
176   * @see AmbiguousDateTime for more details on timezone handling
177   */
178  @NonNull
179  static IDateTimeItem valueOf(@NonNull AmbiguousDateTime value) {
180    return value.hasTimeZone()
181        ? IDateTimeWithTimeZoneItem.valueOf(value.getValue())
182        : new DateTimeWithoutTimeZoneItemImpl(value);
183  }
184
185  @Override
186  default boolean hasDate() {
187    return true;
188  }
189
190  @Override
191  default boolean hasTime() {
192    return true;
193  }
194
195  @Override
196  default int getYear() {
197    return asZonedDateTime().getYear();
198  }
199
200  @Override
201  default int getMonth() {
202    return asZonedDateTime().getMonthValue();
203  }
204
205  @Override
206  default int getDay() {
207    return asZonedDateTime().getDayOfMonth();
208  }
209
210  @Override
211  default int getHour() {
212    return asZonedDateTime().getHour();
213  }
214
215  @Override
216  default int getMinute() {
217    return asZonedDateTime().getMinute();
218  }
219
220  @Override
221  default int getSecond() {
222    return asZonedDateTime().getSecond();
223  }
224
225  @Override
226  default int getNano() {
227    return asZonedDateTime().getNano();
228  }
229
230  /**
231   * Get the date as a {@link LocalDate}.
232   *
233   * @return the date
234   */
235  @NonNull
236  default LocalDateTime asLocalDateTime() {
237    return ObjectUtils.notNull(asZonedDateTime().toLocalDateTime());
238  }
239
240  /**
241   * Get the date as a {@link LocalDate}.
242   *
243   * @return the date
244   */
245  @NonNull
246  default LocalDate asLocalDate() {
247    return ObjectUtils.notNull(asZonedDateTime().toLocalDate());
248  }
249
250  /**
251   * Get the date/time as a {@link LocalTime}.
252   *
253   * @return the time
254   */
255  @NonNull
256  default LocalTime asLocalTime() {
257    return ObjectUtils.notNull(asZonedDateTime().toLocalTime());
258  }
259
260  /**
261   * Get the date/time as an {@link OffsetTime}.
262   *
263   * @return the time
264   */
265  @NonNull
266  default OffsetTime asOffsetTime() {
267    return ObjectUtils.notNull(asZonedDateTime().toOffsetDateTime().toOffsetTime());
268  }
269
270  /**
271   * Get the date/time as a date item.
272   *
273   * @return the date portion of this date/time
274   */
275  @NonNull
276  default IDateItem asDate() {
277    return IDateItem.valueOf(asZonedDateTime(), hasTimezone());
278  }
279
280  /**
281   * Get the date/time as a time item.
282   *
283   * @return the time portion of this date/time
284   */
285  @NonNull
286  default ITimeItem asTime() {
287    return ITimeItem.valueOf(asOffsetTime(), hasTimezone());
288  }
289
290  /**
291   * Get a date/time that has an explicit timezone.
292   * <p>
293   * If this date/time has a timezone, then this timezone is used. Otherwise, the
294   * implicit timezone is used from the dynamic context to create a new date/time.
295   *
296   * @param dynamicContext
297   *          the dynamic context used to get the implicit timezone
298   * @return the date/time with the timezone normalized using UTC-based timezone
299   */
300  @NonNull
301  default IDateTimeItem normalize(@NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) {
302    IDateTimeItem retval = hasTimezone()
303        ? this
304        : replaceTimezone(dynamicContext.getImplicitTimeZoneAsDayTimeDuration());
305    return valueOf(
306        ObjectUtils.notNull(retval.asZonedDateTime().withZoneSameInstant(ZoneOffset.UTC)),
307        true);
308  }
309
310  /**
311   * Get this date/time in the UTC timezone.
312   *
313   * @return the date/time in UTC
314   */
315  default IDateTimeItem asDateTimeZ() {
316    return ZoneOffset.UTC.equals(getZoneOffset())
317        ? this
318        : valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(asZonedDateTime().withZoneSameLocal(ZoneOffset.UTC)), hasTimezone());
319  }
320
321  /**
322   * Adjusts an xs:dateTime value to a specific timezone, or to no timezone at
323   * all.
324   * <p>
325   * This method does one of the following things based on the arguments.
326   * <ol>
327   * <li>If the provided offset is {@code null} and the provided date/time value
328   * has a timezone, the timezone is maked absent.
329   * <li>If the provided offset is {@code null} and the provided date/time value
330   * has an absent timezone, the date/time value is returned.
331   * <li>If the provided offset is not {@code null} and the provided date/time
332   * value has an absent timezone, the date/time value is returned with the new
333   * timezone applied.
334   * <li>Otherwise, the provided timezone is applied to the date/time value
335   * adjusting the time instant.
336   * </ol>
337   * <p>
338   * Implements the XPath 3.1 <a href=
339   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-adjust-dateTime-to-timezone">fn:adjust-dateTime-to-timezone</a>
340   * function.
341   *
342   * @param offset
343   *          the timezone offset to use or {@code null}
344   * @return the adjusted date/time value
345   * @throws DateTimeFunctionException
346   *           with code
347   *           {@link DateTimeFunctionException#INVALID_TIME_ZONE_VALUE_ERROR} if
348   *           the offset is &lt; -PT14H or &gt; PT14H
349   */
350  @Override
351  default IDateTimeItem replaceTimezone(@Nullable IDayTimeDurationItem offset) {
352    return offset == null
353        ? hasTimezone()
354            ? valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(asZonedDateTime().withZoneSameLocal(ZoneOffset.UTC)), false)
355            : this
356        : hasTimezone()
357            ? valueOf(
358                ObjectUtils.notNull(asZonedDateTime().withZoneSameInstant(offset.asZoneOffset())),
359                true)
360            : valueOf(
361                ObjectUtils.notNull(asZonedDateTime().withZoneSameLocal(offset.asZoneOffset())),
362                true);
363  }
364
365  /**
366   * Cast the provided type to this item type.
367   *
368   * @param item
369   *          the item to cast
370   * @return the original item if it is already this type, otherwise a new item
371   *         cast to this type
372   * @throws InvalidValueForCastFunctionException
373   *           if the provided {@code item} cannot be cast to this type
374   */
375  @NonNull
376  static IDateTimeItem cast(@NonNull IAnyAtomicItem item) {
377    IDateTimeItem retval;
378    if (item instanceof IDateTimeItem) {
379      retval = (IDateTimeItem) item;
380    } else if (item instanceof IDateItem) {
381      IDateItem date = (IDateItem) item;
382      retval = valueOf(date.asZonedDateTime(), date.hasTimezone());
383    } else if (item instanceof IStringItem || item instanceof IUntypedAtomicItem) {
384      try {
385        retval = valueOf(item.asString());
386      } catch (IllegalStateException | InvalidTypeMetapathException ex) {
387        // asString can throw IllegalStateException exception
388        throw new InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(ex);
389      }
390    } else {
391      throw new InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(
392          String.format("unsupported item type '%s'", item.getClass().getName()));
393    }
394    return retval;
395  }
396
397  @Override
398  default IDateTimeItem castAsType(IAnyAtomicItem item) {
399    return cast(item);
400  }
401}
